source: 728 Tracking
target: 728 Vestigatio

source: Lumian, Franca, and Jenna’s eyes widened as they caught sight of the strange golden lamp, making a bold conjecture.
target: Oculi Lumiani, Francae, et Jennae dilatati sunt, cum speciem lampadis aureae insolitae conspexissent, audacem coniecturam facientes.

source: Could it be 0-05, the Magic Wishing Lamp?
target: Num sit 0‑05, Lampas Magica Votiva?

source: Yes, the pumpkin carriage is one of Major Arcana Ma’am Hermit’s trademark symbols.
target: Ita, carruca cucurbitae est una ex insignibus typicis Dominae Eremitae Majorum Arcanae.

source: She has close ties to Element Dawn’s leader—Emperor Roselle’s eldest daughter—and the current owner of 0-05, Bernadette.
target: Ea arctos nexus habet cum duce Elementi Aurorae—filia maioris imperatoris Roselle—et hodierna possessor 0‑05, Bernadetta.

source: It isn’t outside the realm of possibility that she might have borrowed the Magic Wishing Lamp…
target: Neque est impossibile ut illa Lampam Magicam Votivam mutuaverit…

source: As these thoughts raced through their minds, they heard Anthony’s respectful greeting, “Good evening, Madam Magician, Madam Judgment.”
target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentes eorum festinabant, audiverunt salutem reverentem a Antonio: “Bona vespera, Domina Magica, Domina Iudicium.”

source: Snapping out of their momentary trance, Lumian and the others quickly followed suit with their own greetings.
target: Ex eorum brevi extasi evasis, Lumian et ceteri celeriter se salutaverunt.

source: “And this is Ma’am Hermit,” Magician added briefly.
target: “Et ecce, haec est Domina Eremita,” addidit Domina Magica breviter.

source: Once the introductions were complete, the woman in the beige dress with a gold-embroidered high collar retrieved a bottle of dark‑red wine from the void and said to Franca, “Hand over that cufflink. Once you do, you can all head home and get some rest.”
target: Cum introductiones completae fuerunt, femina in veste cana cum colla altissima auro inscripta lagena vini obscuri rubri e inane extraxit et Francae dixit: “Tradite illam fibulam. Cum id feceritis, omnes domum redire potestis et quiescere.”

source: Confronting the School of Truth’s Overseer was clearly a battle at the demigod level.
target: Opponere Moderatori Scholae Veritatis plane erat certamen ad gradum semideorum.

source: It wasn’t something Lumian and company could get involved in.
target: Non erat res in quam Lumian et ceteri implicari possent.

source: Franca had no intention of forcing the issue.
target: Franca non intendebat rem impellere.

source: She handed the glass‑like cufflink to Madam Magician.
target: Illam fibulam quasi vitream tradidit Dominae Magicae.

source: In exchange, Madam Magician gave her the wine bottle containing a faint dark‑red liquid.
target: Pro hoc, Domina Magica ei tradidit lagena vini, quae tenuem liquorem rubri obscuri continebat.

source: “This is a mystical item that restores stamina and spirituality after drinking it.
target: Hoc est obiectum mysticum, quod robur et spiritualitatem reficit postquam bibitur.

source: But remember, you can only have it once a day. Don’t go turning into a drunkard.”
target: Sed memento, id solum semel die capere potes. Noli id inebriatum fieri.

source: Just one more sip and you’ll become a drunkard?
target: Unum tantum sorbum et inebriatus fies?

source: Franca and the others instantly understood the deeper meaning behind Madam Magician’s final warning.
target: Franca et ceteri statim intellexerunt sensum profundum post ultimam admonitionem Dominae Magicae.

source: Seeing only a single sip of dark‑red wine in the bottle, Franca turned to pass the old glass bottle to Lumian.
target: Cum videbat in lagena solum unum sorbum vini obscuri rubri, Franca se convertit ut vetustam lagena vitrea Lumiano traderet.

source: He had expended the most spirituality, after all.
target: Ille enim plurimam spiritualitatem consumaverat.

source: Madam Magician rubbed the Mirror Cufflink between her fingers, a smile playing on her lips.
target: Domina Magica fibulam specularis inter digitos suos fregit, dum risus labris eius luderet.

source: “Don’t worry. You won’t be able to finish it. It’s called Bottomless Wine.”
target: Noli solliciti esse. Non poteris id finire. Id vocatur “Vinum Sine Fondo.”

source: I see… Franca still wanted to give it a shot.
target: Video… Franca tamen id conari volebat.

source: She unscrewed the thin metal cap and downed the light dark‑red wine.
target: Illa detorquevit tenue operculum metallicum et deglutit levis vini obscuri rubri.

source: As the slightly astringent and sweet alcohol slid down her throat, she felt refreshed, as if she’d just had a good night’s sleep and hadn’t been in a fierce battle with Moran Avigny.
target: Dum alcohol paulo astringens et dulcis per guttur eius labebatur, se recreatam sensit, quasi modo optima nocte quiesceret et non esset in acerba pugna cum Moran Avigny.

source: At the same time, she noticed dark‑red liquid seeping from the bottom of the old glass bottle, forming a thin layer of wine.
target: Simul animadvertit liquorem rubri obscuri e fundo veteris lagenae vitreae effluere, tenuem stratum vini formans.

source: It really is bottomless… Franca sighed, handing the old glass bottle to Lumian.
target: Revera sine fundo est… Franca suspiravit, veterem lagena vitrea Lumiano tradens.

source: But just as she reached out, a sudden sense of unease struck her.
target: Sed modo ut extendit manum, subito sensus incommoditatis eam percussit.

source: Acting on instinct, she changed course, intending to let Jenna drink first.
target: Instinctu agens, iter mutavit, intendens ut Jenna primo bibat.

source: Yet upon further reflection, she realized something was even more off!
target: Sed post ulteriores cogitationes, intellexit aliquid etiam magis esse prorsus aberrans!

source: Because she still had to pass it to Lumian afterward!
target: Quia postea eam Lumiano tradere oportebat!

source: Never mind, never mind. No point getting caught up in trivial matters… Franca muttered in her native tongue.
target: Noli, noli. Nullum est momentum in rebus levibus versari… Franca in lingua sua murmurat.

source: Instead, she circled her finger around the bottle and managed to form a thin layer of frost.
target: Pro eo, digitum circa lagena circumduxit et tenuam pelliculam gelidam formare potuit.

source: As the frost naturally fell away, Franca passed the Bottomless Wine to Jenna.
target: Dum pellicula gelida naturaliter lapsa est, Franca “Vinum Sine Fondo” ad Jennam tradidit.

source: Jenna drank the dark‑red wine, mimicked Franca’s actions, and then handed it to Lumian.
target: Jenna vinum obscuri rubri bibit, actiones Francae imitata, deinde illud Lumiano tradidit.

source: Franca breathed a sigh of relief.
target: Franca leviter suspiravit.

source: Lumian paid no mind to the Demonesses’ odd behavior.
target: Lumian non curavit de insolito more daemonarum.

source: He was more concerned about the strange actions of Ma’am Hermit and Madam Magician.
target: Ipse magis sollicitus erat de insolitis actionibus Dominae Eremitae et Dominae Magicae.

source: Ma’am Hermit’s eyes, obscured by lenses, grew dark but remained unfocused, as if staring into a vast expanse.
target: Oculi Dominae Eremitae, ab linteis obtecti, obscuri facti sunt, sed non intendentes, quasi in immensum spatium intuebantur.

source: Countless brilliant specks of light appeared around her, as if she had shrunk the universe and brought it down to the ground.
target: Innumerabilia puncta lucis radiantis circa eam apparuerunt, quasi universum contrahuisset et in terram adduxisset.

source: Performing divination or prophecy before tackling important matters?
target: Num divinare aut prophetare priusquam res maximi momenti aggrediantur?

source: Lumian took the old glass bottle and drank the dark‑red wine.
target: Lumian veterem lagena vitrea arripuit et vinum obscuri rubri bibit.

source: His spirituality rapidly recovered, as if he’d experienced six in the morning.
target: Spiritualitas eius celeriter restituta est, quasi sex horas matutinas haberet.

source: Of course, the portion of accumulated spirituality he had used didn’t “return.”
target: Certe, portio spiritualitatis accumulatae quam usus erat non redibat.

source: Phew, Lumian’s anxiety over his spirituality deficiency had been alleviated.
target: Phew, sollicitudo Lumiani de suo defectu spiritualitatis amota erat.

source: After Anthony drank the Bottomless Wine and returned the mystical item to Madam Magician, the Mirror Cufflink’s dark glow, mixed with starlight, flew out and landed on the Major Arcana card holder’s eye.
target: Postquam Antonius “Vinum Sine Fondo” bibit et obiectum mysticum Dominae Magicae reddidit, fulgor obscurus Fibulae Specularis, cum luce stellarum mixta, evolavit et in oculo tenentis chartae Major Arcana incidit.

source: Madam Magician sent Mirror Cufflink flying toward Franca while extending her hands, grasping the void, and pulling it apart on either side.
target: Domina Magica, extendens manus, vacuum arripiens et utrumque latus tollens, misit Fibulam Specularis volitare ad Francam.

source: Without a sound, the void ripped open like a transparent membrane, revealing passageways formed by spiderwebs of emptiness and darkness.
target: Sine sono, vacuum discidit ut membrana translucida, transitus revelans contextos ex rete vacuitatis et tenebris.

source: This was a standard mirror world.
target: Hoc erat mundus specularis ordinarius.

source: Magician had opened an illusory door to the mirror world without using a mirror!
target: Domina Magica aperuit ianuam illusoriam ad mundum specularis, sine speculum utens!

source: Is this the advanced power of the Apprentice pathway? Lumian and company inwardly marveled.
target: Num haec est potestas provecta viae discipuli? Lumian et ceteri intime mirabantur.

source: Madam Magician glanced at Ma’am Hermit beside her.
target: Domina Magica intuita est ad Dominam Eremitam iuxta se.

source: The Hermit, wearing a purple robe, held a vibrant, unreal ball of yarn in her right hand.
target: Domina Eremita, induta toga purpurea, tenebat globulum filorum vividum et irreale in manu dextra.

source: She wound its thread around the peculiar golden lamp.
target: Ipsa filum convolvit circa lampam auream insolitam.

source: Then, the Major Arcana card holder tossed the vivid and illusory ball of yarn through the illusory door Magician had opened, into the mirror world’s dark and ethereal tunnels.
target: Tum, possessor chartae Major Arcana, globulum filorum vividum atque illusorium per ianuam illusoriam quam Domina Magica aperuerat, in tuniculos obscuros et aetheros mundi specularis coniecit.

source: The ball of yarn rolled into one of the passageways and quickly vanished into the depths, leaving only the thread connected to the golden lamp to mark its path.
target: Globulus filorum in unum ex viis decurrit et celeriter in profundum evanuit, relinquens solum filum ad lampam auream conexum, ut iter eius signaret.

source: Magician immediately led The Hermit and Judgment into the mirror world, chasing the ball of yarn.
target: Domina Magica statim duxit Dominam Eremitam et Dominam Iudicium in mundum specularis, globulum filorum insequens.

source: After their figures disappeared from the mirror world, the forcibly torn void rapidly closed.
target: Postquam figurae eorum ex mundo speculari evanuerunt, vacuum, vi laniatum, celeriter se clausit.

source: Franca muttered again, “I think I’ve heard the story about a yarn ball before, but I can’t recall its name…”
target: Franca iterum murmurat: “Puto me prius fabulam de globulo filorum audivisse, sed nomen eius recolere nequeo…”

source: Lumian turned his attention back to Moran Avigny’s corpse.
target: Lumian animadvertit ad cadaver Moran Avigny.

source: “You want to bring him back for your godson to eat?” Franca said with contempt.
target: “Visne eum reducere ut filius dei tui eum edat?” inquit Franca cum contemnione.

source: “Let’s not even discuss whether Ludwig should be eating humans in the first place.
target: “Ne quidem de hoc agamus, an Ludwig homines edere debeat ex initio.

source: A Mirror Person’s flesh will gradually turn back into mirror fragments. Do you really want Ludwig to be eating glass shards?”
target: Caro personae specularis gradatim in fragmenta specularia redibit. Num vere vis ut Ludwig vitri frusta edat?”

source: Lumian shook his head.
target: Lumian caput concussit.

source: “I’m considering whether I should take Moran Avigny’s makeup mirror.”
target: “Cogito num speculum ornamentale Moran Avigny tollere debeam.”

source: After tracking the vibrant yarn for a while, the three Major Arcana card holders reached a country villa matching the mirror’s coordinates and spotted the target mirror on a desk.
target: Postquam per aliquod tempus globulum filorum vibrantem secuti sunt, tres possessor chartarum Majorum Arcana in villam rusticanam, quarum coordinationes speculi conveniebant, pervenerunt et speculum destinatum in scrinio conspexerunt.

source: It was also a makeup mirror.
target: Etiam erat speculum ornamentale.

source: They didn’t pause.
target: Non morati sunt.

source: They followed the ball of yarn and walked through the spirit world.
target: Illi globulum filorum secuti sunt et per mundum spiritale ambulaverunt.

source: In a mere two to three seconds, they returned to reality and saw the vivid and illusory ball of yarn come to a halt in a dark cathedral lacking a deity’s statue.
target: In duobus ad tribus secundis, ad realitatem redierunt et conspexerunt globulum filorum vividum atque illusorium in obscura cathedralia, cuius statua deitatis defuit, consistere.

source: Beneath the cathedral’s dome, humans hung in the air, gently swaying in the wind.
target: Sub cupola cathedralis, homines in aere suspendebantur, leniter in vento oscillantes.

source: Some were old, some were young, and some were gentlemen wearing half top hats.
target: Alii senes erant, alii iuvenes, et alii domini, qui pileos dimidiatos gerebant.

source: Some were beautiful ladies in vintage dresses, some were tall and muscular like giants, and some were covered in wet, sticky scales resembling fish…
target: Aliae erant pulchrae feminae in vestimentis veteranorum modorum, alii alti et musculosi velut gigantes, et alii in squamis madidis et adhaerentibus, quae piscibus similes erant, operti erant…

source: What they all had in common was their firmly closed eyes, suspended by invisible ropes, looking like hanged corpses.
target: Quod omnes habebant commune, oculi eorum firmiter clausi erant, funibus invisibilibus suspendentes, et similes cadaveribus adpositis videbantur.

source: In the cathedral’s depths, a man in his thirties with average facial features and dark hair sat in a wooden black armchair.
target: In profundis cathedralis, vir annos triginta fere habens, vultu mediocri et capillis obscuris, in solio ligneo nigro sedebat.

source: His aura and soul felt both familiar and unfamiliar to Magician.
target: Eius aura et anima Dominae Magicae tam nota quam ignota videbantur.

source: It was familiar because she recognized Loki, the head of April Fool’s, who had been compelled to exhaust his resurrection times.
target: Erat familiaris, quia agnovit Lokum, caput Aprilis Stultorum, qui ad exhaurendas resurrectionis tempora coactus fuerat.

source: It was unfamiliar because the other party had been stained with an odd sensation.
target: Erat ignotum, nam altera pars inusitato sensu tincta erat.

source: At that instant, a blurry female figure stood next to Loki, resembling a sketch.
target: Illo momento, figura feminea nebulosa iuxta Lokum stabat, quasi delineata.

source: Her eyes were pitch‑black, like a lake in the dim night.
target: Oculi eius erant atri, ut lacus in obscura nocte.

source: He looked at Magician, The Hermit, and Judgment, a smile playing on his lips.
target: Ille spectavit Dominam Magicam, Dominam Eremitam, et Dominam Iudicium, cum risus in labiis eius luderet.

source: “It’s all thanks to you that I found some hope of returning.”
target: “Gratias tibi ago, per te spem redire inveni.”

source: Before Loki could finish his sentence, the suspended corpses’ eyes snapped open simultaneously.
target: Antequam Loki sermonem conficere potuisset, oculi cadaverum suspendendorum simul aperti sunt.

source: Those eyes were pitch‑black.
target: Illi oculi erant atri.

source: In the quarry cave with a fixed entrance to the mirror world.
target: In spelunca lapidea cum fixo ingressu ad mundum specularis.

source: “Taking away Moran Avigny’s makeup mirror?” Jenna echoed Lumian’s words before a realization struck her.
target: “Speculum ornamentale Moran Avigny auferre?” Jenna verba Lumiani repetivit, antequam ei intellexit aliquid.

source: “Do you want to see if any other Mirror People will try to contact Moran Avigny before news of his mysterious disappearance spreads?”
target: “Visne videre an alii Homines Speculares conentur Moran Avigny contingere, antequam nuntius de eius mysteriosa evanitione diffundatur?”

source: “Patience is a virtue,” Lumian replied with a smile.
target: “Patientia est virtus,” respondit Lumian cum risu.

source: For a Hunter, this was an essential quality.
target: Pro Venatore, haec erat qualitas necessaria.

source: He stooped down and retrieved the makeup mirror from Moran Avigny’s corpse’s pocket.
target: Ille se inclinavit et speculum ornamentale ex sinu cadaveris Moran Avigny extraxit.

source: At that moment, the makeup mirror snapped open.
target: In illo momento, speculum ornamentale subito aperitum est.

source: It opened on its own!
target: Ipse per se aperuit!

source: Dark light surged from the palm‑sized glass mirror, instantly filling the dimly lit quarry cave.
target: Lux obscura ex speculo vitreo, cuius magnitudo similis palmae erat, effluit, statim speluncam lapideam parum illuminatam replens.

source: In the next instant, Lumian, Franca, and the others saw a figure quickly take shape beside the fixed entrance to the mirror world on the protruding rock.
target: In sequenti momento, Lumian, Franca, et ceteri vidērunt figuram celeriter formari iuxta ingressum fixum ad mundum specularis in saxo eminente.

source: It was a stunning woman with black hair and brown eyes.
target: Erat femina stupenda, capillis nigris et oculis fuscis.

source: She wore a bright red dress with layers of embroidery and lace, revealing a large expanse of snow‑white skin on her chest despite the cold winter.
target: Induta erat veste rubra splendida, cum stratis insculptis et laciniatis, quae magnam partem cutis niveae in pectore patefaciabat, non obstante frigore hiemali.

source: A friendly smile graced her face.
target: Subridens, risus amicus faciem eius ornabat.

source: Perle?
target: Perle?

source: The renowned courtesan in Trier, Perle, the theater actress from the Loen Kingdom?
target: Notissima cortigiana Trevirensis, Perle, actrix theatri ex Regno Loen?

source: Lumian was shocked and at a loss. He hadn’t expected to encounter this flamboyant courtesan in such a setting.
target: Lumian obstupefactus et perplectus erat; non speraverat talem cortigianam pomposam in tali ambitu occurrem.

source: Franca, Jenna, and Anthony also found the situation surreal and hard to believe.
target: Franca, Jenna, et Antonius quoque rem insolitam atque incredibilem esse putabant.

source: Almost simultaneously, Lumian recalled two key facts related to Perle.
target: Fere simul, Lumian duas res claves de Perle recordatus est.

source: The first time he had observed Moran Avigny, Perle had been on a date with her new lover in the hotel’s annex restaurant.
target: Primum, cum Moran Avigny conspexisset, Perle cum novo amatore suo in restaurante annexo deversorii cenaverat.

source: All courtesans were standard, textbook brokers—political brokers!
target: Omnes cortigianae erant prorsus standard, instar exemplorum librorum—mediatrices politicas!

source: Combining these two points, a guess formed in Lumian’s mind.
target: His duobus rebus coniunctis, coniectura in mente Lumiani orta est.

source: Could Perle also be a member of the School of Truth?
target: Num Perle etiam membrum Scholae Veritatis sit?

source: Could she be the Overseer that Jebus directly reported to, the bestowed of an evil god at the demigod level?
target: Num illa esset Moderator cui Jebus directe referret, donata a deo malo ad gradum semidei?

source: If that’s the case, where did Madam Magician and the others end up? Who were they tracking?
target: Si ita sit, quo Domina Magica et ceteri pervenerunt? Quem insequebantur?

source: Flee! We must flee immediately!
target: Fuge! Statim fugere debemus!

source: At that moment, Perle looked at Lumian and the others, a smile forming on her lips as she uttered the Words of Order.
target: Illo momento, Perle spectavit ad Lumian et ceteros, cum risus in labiis eius efflorescentes, verba Ordinis proferens.

source: “Your crimes remain unpunished!”
target: “Crimina vestra impune manent!”
